The test image shows a tomato field with plants severely wilted and collapsed, foliage still green, stems failing at or near the base. This whole-plant sudden collapse pattern points strongly to a bacterial wilt disease.

Now I'll view one reference image for Bacterial_Wilt.

The reference image shows bacterial streaming from a cut stem in water — the diagnostic sign of Bacterial_Wilt (Ralstonia solanacearum). The test image shows the field presentation: sudden, complete whole-plant collapse with foliage still green, plants sprawled on white plastic mulch. This pattern — rapid total wilt without leaf spotting, browning, or mold — is classic for bacterial wilt.
